nom: Sun Bum Mineral Sunscreen Face Tint SPF 30

avis.texte: ɓɓn̈ǰŕnWhat's different about this skin tint is that this one tube is suitable for all skintones! I didn't believe it at first, but I tested it out on my mom, who has a medium tan with a more golden tone. I have very pale, ghostly cool tone skin. this product works for both of us! I love this stuff and wear it every day as my foundation. It's light feeling and covers nicely. The finish is satin.
Silky. Light weight. Easy to apply. Subtle shade. Wouldn't object to having the option for a slightly darker shade for better coverage.

This stuff rocks. Super lightweight, almost whipped consistency, so you don't even know you're wearing anything. No shine, wears matte. Doesn't smell so it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. And I haven't burned after being outside all day! Coverage is very very light, would not say it's comparable to CC cream in terms of coverage.

I am a Floridian who for years has used SunBum Mineral Tinted Sunscreen for face. Oh, had it been available in my youth! I must say that its defining difference for me is its feel on my face. This is a silken primer that actually has useful, healthful properties. The tint is a plus too.

This is literally THE BEST mineral face sunscreen ever!!! Goes on so velvety smooth and hides pores! Sometimes I put it on just to hide my pores even if it's dark outside already lol. I have been using for years and I just hope it never gets discontinued or changed! Only thing that would make it even better is if they made it SPF 50! Thanks sun bum :)
The quality of the lotion was great. It went on smoothly and didn't clog my pores. The coverage is great, I would use this daily.

The color on the screen does not refect the color in reality. The color that came out of the tube is a grayish white color, it doesn't work on a light brown skinned girl. The consistency is so thick that it wiped out my color, making me look sallow. I had to compensate by using a liquid bronzer underneath to give my skin a light brown glow. I love the light airy texure, though, it feels like a mousse, I just wished the color was deeper, I really wanted to like this one.
Im not sure I love the mineral texture on my face but that is my bad, I like the color and feel once it is on tho
I have used this for a couple of years, and it has very nice coverage without feeling heavy or cakey. Plus it protects my face
I'm in love with the light airy texture and smooth finish this product has. It's a staple for my summer routine.

this has been my favorite sunscreen for my face and i've tried many, living in Florida and being outside all the time. it goes on so nicely, doesn't feel like there is a residue, feels genuinely lovely to put on, unlike other sunscreens. seems to do the trick- i never get burned and i'm outside a lot. i am prone to acne and have sensitive skin and this product does not aggravate my skin.

I love my tinted mineral sunscreen. I have rosacea so this is the only tinted sunscreen that I actually like. The only downside is that it leaves particles of tint all over my face after applying it. Still trying to figure out if it's me or the product though but it doesn't bother me that much. The feeling and the finish are fantastic!

The best sunscreen! I use it instead of make up and it gives you a nice flow and keeps your skin protected from the sun. Love the zinc mineral base. I also read that zinc is great for acne or rosacea - which women in their 50s tend to get… Sun Bum doesn't skimp on quality! Good stuff ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I LOVE this stuff! I don't wear foundation anymore, just this every day now for years. The color is just a tint to even out my complexion and with just a little setting powder I'm good to go! This has a matte finish that gives a very smooth and natural look to my skin. It's a mousse like texture that glides on beautifully. Sunscreen and skin perfection in one.

I don't like foundation but somehow this feels different. I slap it on over my moisturizer and it has just enough tint to even out my skin tone. No scent, no break outs, no white cast, no oily glaze. Just a light, matte finish. Perfect.
The only tint it leaves is from the white cast. Also, this is a standalone product, if you try to use it under makeup, it gets blotchy due to it not rubbing in your skin all the way.

avis.titre: So amazing, silky, smooth, and easy to apply
avis.texte: I love it so much! I wear it daily just on my face and it looks so natural and shiny! If you are looking for a gentle tinted sunscreen this it the thing to do! Also I wear it as a foundation and even though I really only wear blush and mascara it is super nice for when your skin breaks out!
While I liked the coverage it had on my skin, it made me break out in a bunch of little white heads almost rash like Im not sure why
While I liked the coverage it had on my skin, it made me break out in a bunch of little white heads almost rash like Im not sure why
It is thr greaiest product ever. I wish i could get my money back

Our family loves this stuff! Even the littles! I just ask them to come over for a "face massage" and they literally line up to have this applied to their adorable little faces. The Mr. and I like it bc it's mineral but *tinted* so we don't look anemic while enjoying outdoor life. Thanks Sun Bum!
Great product, with perfect color, coverage, and sun protection. Recommend to all our patients!

It does not tint at all. Its no different than applying regular sunscreen. I was hoping to replace my current tinted moisturizer with something more affordable, but this isnt it. I have pale skin, so it should have done something. It is water resistent however. So, thats a plus i guess.

Pros: The tint helps to not have white-cast. It protects from uv rays for short periods. Looks matte Cons: It doesn't rub in to the skin all the way and slides around. It looks matte but it feels like unset pore-filling primer. Have to powder and use setting spray so it doesn't transfer.
This is the worst mineral sunscreen I've ever used. It feels like 100% silicone on the skin. Will never buy this brand again.

avis.titre: Absolutely love it!  It's an amazing primer!
avis.texte: I've never liked primer, the ones I tried didn't work with my foundation. I was researching tinted primers and liked a recommendation for the Sun Bum tinted primer as they said it was matte and I hate being shiny. This goes on so silky smooth! It makes my skin look so much better and my foundation just glides on beautifully and stays all day. Now I have solved 2 issues by finding a sunscreen I'll wear regularly and a great primer.

There is absolutely NO tint in this tinted sunscreen. I wasn't expecting anything crazy but it literally looked no different. For a product advertising TINTED I was definitely expecting more. I have a very light complexion as well, so it's not hard.
Blends well, moisturizing, doesn't sting my eyes or irritate skin. Doesn't pill under makeup. Slight tint is nice, no white cast. One of the best mineral sunscreens I've used.

I have been using this one for a few years now. I first put on my moisturizer let that dry then I put this on which acts a little bit like a primer and then I will add my tinted moisturizer over the top. No foundation nothing else sometimes just a little bit of powder if I feel like it. When I give each step a few minutes to dry down it just really does very very well for me. I hope they continue to make it. This was recommended by my favorite dermatologist utuber. She never leeads me in the wrong direction.

After trying multiple facial sunscreens, this remains my favorite. It's great even for those with sensitive skin, no eye irritation. No odd cast, blends well, moisturizing, can be worn alone or under makeup.

I have a pretty extensive morning skin care routine but even after waiting a half hour, the sunscreen immediately pilled when I put it on. I could use less, but I want to make sure I'm covered. If I need something quick to slap on before a morning walk, this is great. But not for everyday use.

A lot of the sunscreens I tried made my skin too shiny but this one feels great and doesn't leave me shiny. The tinted color helps with the white cast which goes away within 15ish minutes if it leaves any. My skin absorbs it nicely and doesn't feel heavy.
This tinted sunscreen is perfect for a hint of color to even out your skin. Love it on the weekends to save my fancier tinted moisturizer for workdays.

best coverage for acne ive ever gotten with a sun screen! if i dont have time to put on foundation i use this on my acne. only problem is that it can cling to dry spots IF u do not do the right skincare prep before applying. will be purchasing again!

This is a very comfortable mineral sunscreen if you have normal skin type. This stuck to my dry patches and gave hardly any tint. I will say that it is comfortable around my eyes though. If you're dry like me, try the Eucerin tinted sunscreen instead of this. Its amazing, offers a strong tint, and does what I wish this product would.

I really wanted to love this product because it is very silky and comfortable, and the tint is just enough to disappear on my skin. The only problem is I have quite oily skin and this product never fully sets down on me. It can be hours later and I touch my face and it comes right off. I have tried powdering my face which helped a little, but I think I'm going to use the rest of it as a body SPF. If you are very oily like me, I can't recommend this one but maybe give the Australian Gold tinted SPF50 a try.

I've been on the hunt for a good mineral sunscreen. I tried the CeraVe tinted sunscreen and I liked it a lot (hate the non tinted one, terrible white cast) but I wanted to get another that didn't seem like makeup foundation so my husband could also use it. This tinted sunbum one we both use. I'm light skin but he is dark skin and he does NOT get q white cast so it's a winner since l can't get him to use sunscreen often because of the strong smell or white cast. only reason I lowered a point was because it has very little product for the price.

I bought this product because I wanted something with sunscreen in it and I like that it had a tint to it. It works well and looks natural and feels good. I have oily skin but this is actually matte and acts like a primer in my opinion. Easy to use and works great. It does separate with the sunscreen in there so just be sure to mix before squeezing some out.

I have used this only a few times, but so far, so good. I am very sensitive to the chemical suncreens, so I appreciate a mineral sunscreen for the face that is actually useful. This functions as a light foundation for me, as I don't wear much as a rule. There is no eye or skin irritation, it feels light and non-greasy. I haven't been in the sun for extended periods of time with it.

I've used tinited sunscreen before, but this stuff made me look like a zombie. I looked like the undertaker did my make-up. If I died, this would be the complexion of my skin. If you have pigmentation (read - black / brown skin tone), SAVE your money! I'm definitely returning. No wonder it was by one, get one 40% off … they are trying to give it away!

avis.titre: Gave me pimples but it's still ok
avis.texte: I used this entire tube… But I wont be repurchasing. While it didnt leave a cast on my skin and had a nice smoothing quality and tint when applied, it caused me to breakout. It would cause these little whiteheads to form all over my face. They were easy enough to get rid of but such a shame because I think this product has a lot of pros, I just have really sensitive skin and acne so it is not for me.
felt nice when applying, after about an hour my skin was very dry and tight.

avis.titre: Think of it as a "Non Drying Primer with Sunscreen"
avis.texte: I have mature, light-medium, neutral undertone skin with lots of imperfections. I am most comfortable with a tinted moisturizer, primer and blush. Most sunscreens feel heavy on my skin; ditto with foundations. And anything that feels thick or heavy also makes me itch. In an effort to avoid the constant scratching, I decided to use only mineral based sunscreen products. I've tried everything from CeraVe to Drunk Elephant and La Roche Pose to Elta, yet nothing seems to be what I can wear all day comfortably. I tried this for the first time yesterday and I was impressed! I applied a light moisturizer to my clean face, and then, following other's comments, shook the tube really well, and applied the dermatologist-recommended 1/2 teaspoon. Although it felt like a lot, it was lightweight, the color blended in easily, it soaked in quickly, and did a great job of serving as a primer. It is definitely a matte finish. I let it dry, applied concealer and blush over it, and left the house. Sixteen hours later, it was still intact, none had accumulated in my "creases" or under my eyes, and I hadn't scratched my face at all. It came off easily with one shot of my regular salicylic acid face wash and my skin felt fine. I did the whole thing again today, and having just washed it off, there are no signs of irritation, outbreaks, extra dryness, excessive oil, etc. I am purchasing another tube today because I can't believe this is so effective for me and it is at this price point. Tomorrow I w

I love this product!!!! I am a very plae person who doesnt really love to wear foundation. So this js perfect for me. It gives me just the "tint" that my skin needs to look like im alive. It applies so smoothly and makes my skin feel like velvet. I have very dry skin so i wear lotion underneath it to help my skin not look too matte. Truly though, love this product. It lasts forever!

avis.titre: Not as Tinted as Product Photo Shows
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this product, especially the level of tint as I'm a medium skin tone and mineral SPFs leave quite the white cast on my skin. I'm totally disappointed. It's more like an offset for the white cast, not like a tinted moisturizer.

avis.titre: BEST ever sunscreen and primer in 1 step.
avis.texte: Please never stop making this. If this is all I wear my skin looks flawless. May also use under regular foundation. The primer power is legit. The sunscreen is perfect. Buy it.

avis.titre: Amazing and better when you get to the end of a tube
avis.texte: This is so far my go to tinted sunscreen from ULTA, and weirdly it's better and less greasy when you get to the end of squeezing out a tube and have to cut it open to get the rest. it becomes this thick mousse texture that soaks in wonderfully. I am also very very fair skinned and this makes me look pretty orange if I use it on its own, so I mix it with white Biossance sunscreen with no cast and it works great. 4 stars only because of how greasy it is until you get to the end of a tube.

I wear this in place of my foundation. It covers pretty good and has a mat finish. I replaced my foundation with it when Covid hit because it didn't cause any breakouts under my mask and it still keeps my skin clear.

avis.titre: Nice but you have to clean it
avis.texte: Loved the texture and color, blends smoothly and provides enough protection until noon if applied in the morning. Didn't notice any rub off my face. I have normal skin and if I didn't clean it, cloughs my pores and I get breakouts. I use it daily so it adds time to my night routine as a must cleanse product.

avis.titre: Pretty Good, but leaves white film
avis.texte: I feel like This product does it's job, I just would like something more light weight that applies clear on skin. This can be a little hard to rub in, even when I use just a little bit I feel like I have a white film over my face and feels a bit greasy. Once dry though, it does feel really smooth and moisturizing. Definitely does not irritate the skin! Overall if you don't mind the white tint, then this product does the job! But I prefer something of a lighter consistency.

avis.titre: A dream come true with a great price
avis.texte: This product is exactly what I was looking for. I don't wear any face/skin make up but I needed a good sunscreen that was mineral. This is perfect with the tint, I am pretty pale but the tint isn't enough to make me look like my early 2000s self. I love the matte finish!! I apply a lotion underneath and this works wonders. And can I point out the price??? You can not find a good sunscreen for this price!!

avis.titre: The best mineral sunscreen out there
avis.texte: I've tried a bunch of mineral sunscreens, and this is the best by far. I like it even more than my chemical ones. I'm very sensitive and most other (higher end) mineral sunscreens gave me a rash and broke me out, but my skin is so happy with this.
At first this sunscreen is really matte which I liked because I have oil skin but after a while it makes your skin super greasy.

avis.titre: One of my favorite tinted mineral sunscreens
avis.texte: This is one of my favorite tinted mineral sunscreens. It has a mousse-like texture which blends easily on the skin. The finish is fairly matte but not a super-dry matte, and it gives a bit of coverage. The color looks nice with my light/medium neutral skin tone. I wait until it sets up before applying makeup. Once dry it works well underneath foundation. I haven't had problems with pilling or weird flaking like with some other mineral foundations. It has no scent. It's also affordable!

I have oily skin/sensitive skin and this works very well to keep me matte throughout the day. I apply my vitamin C serum first and let fully absorb. I apply this then dry down. Very smooth application. Then I use Bare Minerals original powder and I am good for the day. Wears well, doesn't rub off and keeps me from becoming grease face all day. Very soft and natural finish. Very happy with purchase.
Fair skin approved! It's like a filter in you're face the only thing I wished was less mate and more glowy / hydrating but this is my personal preference overall great great sunscreen

avis.titre: Used this daily for last two years
avis.texte: Great multi-purpose product that gives me spf protection and a bit of skin-smoothing. Mousse-like texture applies well. Only con is that it comes it a singular color that works on fair skin. Never had a bad reaction to it skinwise.

Some may really love the whipped feel of this but not me. The tint in some tinted sunscreens provide sheer coverage (which I like) but this one does not provide any coverage at all and in fact makes my skin look splotchy under makeup. Really dried my face out. Tried to save some money but it backfired. No hard feelings though sun bum, just not my thing.

I wanted to like this, but ultimately it felt waaay too greasy on my skin. Later throughout the day it was starting to separate and look dry in my T-zone. The search for a good tinted sunscreen continues…

avis.titre: One of my new fav sunscreens
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin, and recently most sunscreens have been breaking it out. I tried this sunbum one and no problems! It seems to protect my skin well against the sun, and feels super creamy and not greasy (which I love). I would compare the feel of it to putting on a moisturizer. The only issue I have with it is that the tint is hardly noticeable. Bought it hoping it would provide some coverage as well, but other than maybe making my skin look slightly less red, it really doesn't.

avis.titre: My HG for a few years now.
avis.texte: Over the years I've realized my skin is just not very compatible with chemical SPF so I've had to find a new mineral daily driver. I tried soooooo many from low high end, and I've landed on this one!! I have super fair, Irish freckly, sensitive skin, so most tinted SPF is too dark/orange for me- ESPECIALLY upon reapplication. This one is literally perfect, I use it in place on place of foundation now bc the finish is so nice. No white cast, no orange cast (lol), unscented, it has the perfect finish- light pore filling, matte finish but doesn't dry me out. I don't have to use a powder over this which makes reapplication sooo easy (wish I remembered this more, but I'm bad about reapplying) This might be too light for darker skin tones, I wish it had a few color options like the Australian Gold, but that one is way too matte, drying, scented, and burns my eyes.

I've needed to start using a facial sunscreen for a LONG time. at nearly 30 years old and after years of UV tanning, sun spots are becoming a concern. I have oily skin, and HATE the feel of sunscreen on my face, but, I'm outside daily for my job. i tried this and LOVE it. literally feels like a tinted moisturizer. no shine, mattefies my face. I'll get A LOT of use out of this one bottle, I don't need to use much. great product!

avis.titre: Similar to Supergoop Mineral Matte Screen
avis.texte: I'd recommend this as a cheaper option/dupe of the Supergoop Mineral Matte Screen. I love both but to save on money, I'd recommend this one more.
It blends in so easily, has a matte finish and tones down my redness. I also love that it's mineral.
Easy to apply, tint is nice. It is very comfortable on oily skin, nice matte finish. I finally found the one!

avis.titre: Upset I didn't buy/know about this sooner!!
avis.texte: I love the feel of this sunscreen as it's going on and then once it's on my face! It's silky and light weight. The tint is just enough to take away some redness on my face!
It goes on so smooth you don't even realize it's sunscreen. Gives just a tiny to blur superficial flaws. Probably could be used as a primer

avis.titre: Lightweight mousse. Great for fair/light skin tones.
avis.texte: This is my first time trying this sunscreen and I love it. It has a mousse-like consistency that flawlessly blends into my skin and feels very lightweight. The tint does not leave an orange hue on my skin and blends in very close to my natural skin tone (fair/light). Not sure how this would look on other skin tones. I prefer this over the Cerave tinted mineral sunscreen, which leaves me looking a little orange, and used to be my go to sunscreen even if the color was off. I was also using Colorscience's sunforgettable total protection sunscreens in matte and classic before trying this sunscreen and I prefer Sun Bum's mineral sunscreen over both of those as they were too liquidy and neither of the colors were a good fit.

avis.titre: Works for my sensitive, acne prone skin
avis.texte: I'm always on the hunt for a good sunscreen with no fragrance or anything possibly irritating due to my skin being very acne prone. I got this one after seeing some good reviews on here and on YouTube. It has really surprised me how well it has worked for me, no irritation, no break outs and actually has made my makeup go on very smoothly and look better throughout the day. The texture took some getting used to, it feels like a mousse/silicone primer, but not overly silicone feeling. I'm Very impressed and glad I found a spf that doesn't break me out!

I've been using this now for probably a week and I really like it. My only complaint is the lid which is very messy to use. Any extra gets sort of stuck around the opening and then gets on the top lid. Definitely needs a redesign. The color and coverage is really nice, but don't expect a full cc cream or a foundation. I use this over the sun bum moisturizer on days that I just don't want to wear make up but want a little bit of tint to even things out and some extra sun protection. I have pretty fair skin but I tend to spend a lot of time in the sun so the color is reasonable.

It goes on very smooth and dry. I like the light tint, you can use it alone or apply under make-up. I tend to have an oily T-zone so I did have to touch up and it flaked off a bit but when I used it with out make-up it worked great!
This is the best sunscreen I've ever used. It doesn't have a white cast and feels like a primer. Bonus is it doesn't irritate my eyes.

I usually use the Australian Gold tinted suncreen but they were sold out so i decided to try this one. This sunscreen was terrible! The texture made it very streaky and difficult to spread, the color was way too light and showed a significant white cast, and it is a bit pricey for an spf 30. Overall, i did not like this product and would not recommend it

This is my favorite sunscreen to use on my neck, chest and shoulders. It blurs imperfections on my 50 something year old skin and is so gentle and non irritating. Its very important to me to avoid chemical sunscreens.

I love the light tint and good spf in this product. I either use it as a primer for day make up or alone when I am working in the sun. Has a matte finish and takes away my sweat shine. I definitely see what people mean by the drying effects so I always put this on after my moisturizer and it seems to help.
i bought this as sunscreen for my face & wanted a tinted sunscreen so make up not necessary. Tint is for very fair skin. i returned product
This sunscreen has a lightweight mousse texture which I really liked. Unfortunately it was too drying for my skin (I have combination skin). The tint also easily transferred to my clothes.
This is the greatest sun screen. Goes on like gossamer. Feels like velvet!!! Love. Love. Love!!!!

Bought because I couldn't find the brand I wanted to try. It has the worst texture of any product I've ever used on my face. Feels like melted cake frosting or something - moussey and oily in the worst way. Does not dry down well, transfers a lot. Only good thing I can say is it's definitely not drying and it doesn't seem to oxidize noticeably.

I've only used this product once so far, so take my review with a grain of salt, but I really like it!! The consistency is great, very smooth. I am also really pale and it blends into my skin well. It is not for you if you're looking for coverage (like a cc cream) or if you wanted it to make you look a lot more than than you are, but I really like it as a sunscreen that makes me look like I was in the sun for an extra hour or so.

I've been eying this for months waiting on my Supergoop Matte Screen to run out. I finally purchased and have used it about 3x now. No issues! The tint is lighter than I'm use to, but leaves no white cast once rubbed in (I am Black, light skinned with an olive/red undertone) I was leery because it contains a few extracts but I researched them and they all have calming/soothing and hydrating aspects, so I'm okay with that. The only factors that separate this from the Supergoop mattescreen is that one has two ingredients to protect against blue light and this one does not. I've had no issues and no breakouts, praise the Lord. Good buy and price. Tinted is also always better for WOC especially with hyperpigmentation concerns.

I still use this while trying to find a different sunscreen. I don't like the consistency of it, and it peels sometimes. I've tried sunscreens that sit better on the skin, but irritated my eyes. This one doesn't that's why I keep using it.

It worked okay for a bit, but after a couple of days it started to become patchy, drying out my skin HEAVILY and that means something especially bc I have oily/combination skin. You have to mix it constantly, and if you don't mix it long enough when you open it liquid starts pouring out like crazy

Putting this on seemed okay at first but then it just got worse and worse. Started pilling really badly, did not absorb, I even washed my face with a double cleanse just to start over and try this on alone with nothing underneath. It was still bad and it made my face feel super super dry and made my face look wrinkly when I don't have wrinkles. I hope I can return this.

Okay. I wasn't expecting to actually like this stuff, but I bought it for a trip to Florida, and it is the best! I will use this on my face from now on! It is tinted, but it's not going to give you any more coverage than a tinted moisturizer.. little to none. BUT, it's not gonna leave a weird white cast on your face or leave your face feeling sticky like normal sunscreen would. If you want coverage, use this under your normal makeup.. it goes on smooth and makes my face feel super soft, not sticky. I bet it would work good as a makeup primer. It saved my face from getting burned while at the beach! There's nothing worse than sunburned foreheads and cheeks! This is summer must! And since I don't typically wear a lot of makeup in the summer anyways, I'm going to start using this instead! Highly recommend!!

I absolutely love this sunscreen. It seems to work like a primer. Not really a tinted sunscreen, it has more of a blurring effect. Love how soft it leaves my skin. I actually use double sunblock. I use a greasy one first then this one on top so my face doesn't feel sticky.

avis.titre: Just doesn't lay on the skin well
avis.texte: I've tried to like this product but just don't. First reaction is it's a little expensive for the size of the product, which I'm willing to speaks if it's a good product. Looks like I'm wearing a foundation that doesn't match and is very drying and flaky! Much better options out there.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: Love how lightweight it is. So creamy and velvety. Love that it does not oxidize. I will be buying this again.

I have been using this for several years and it is absolutely the best face sunscreen ever. it is water resistant and the consistency is amazing. it feels like a makeup primer so it is perfect to put on under makeup. everyone i have had try it out absolutely loves it!

This is the best tinted sunscreen i ve ever used. it doesnt pill, it doesnt leave my face oily, it doesnt even look like i have sunscreen on. this is my go-to one for face from now on. i love it so much
I love this sunscreen is my go to and it's not really expensive.

Works great. Doesn't leave a white cast. A little oily but overall not a problem. I recommend mixing with your foundation because otherwise you'll move it around when you put foundation overtop. Wish it came in a higher SPF but I love it
Not good consistency. Doesn‚'t spread on skin well. The finish is not anywhere close to c/c creams.

I've been searching for a effective and good for my face sunscreen. This product is fantastic, I don't use base during the day anymore! Just put it on and your face is a porcelain. My skin is oily but stays good. Fantastic!
I love the velvet smoothness this feels going on. Feels very luxurious :)

Good sunscreen. The smell and texture is nice and smooth. It's not very tinted but there is no white cast. I would not use if you have dry skin or in the winter. Great for people with normal to oily skin and best used in the summer months.
It really does glide on like butter and it really is matte, but subtle; it's basically the perfect BB cream, it just needs to be in a higher spf!

I am not a huge make up or foundation person. It clogs my pores and causes me to break out. That is why I was looking for a sunscreen with tint. I work at a dermatology office and I would hear my dermatologist always recommend this brand to our patients, so I decided to give it a try and I am so glad I did because it gives an amazing matte finish and helps my skin look great and feel soft! 100% recommend and will continue to recommend to my patients!

First time trying this tinted sunscreen. Blends well into the skin, not at all oily or greasy. Matte finish without being drying and easy to layer my normal makeup routine on top. Acts almost as a primer. No real smell to it. The tint coverage is very light so don't expect it to hide blemishes all that well. It very slightly evens out the skin tone without having the very obvious look of having make up on. All in all quite happy with it!

Idk if I got a bad batch or something, but I had high expectations for this sunscreen going off of the positive reviews and this definitely did not meet them. To start, this DOES NOT absorb into skin, it's like rubbing lotion on a glass window. Considering the amount of sunscreen you need to put on to protect your skin & have to reapply throughout the day, it would be uncomfortable to use this type of formulation everyday. Also, it'll transfer onto anything and everything you touch/wear. So no thanks! I will say that the tint is a nice color. IDK how well it would do on deep/rich toned skin but for my yellow/olive undertones the color worked well. But considering the fact that this WOULD NOT absorb into my skin no matter how long I tried to rub it in & spread it out, it's not worth the price. There's cheaper, more effective tinted sunscreens out there.

avis.titre: Great ‚Äî wish I could buy a bigger tube!
avis.texte: My makeup has SPF in it, so I don‚'t use this for my face. (But, I wouldn‚'t be afraid to!) I use it on my arms for sun protection and the tint improves the appearance of age spots/freckles. No appearance of make-up ‚Äî looks very natural. No concerning ingredients! Love it!

I've purchased Sun Bum sunblock for several years as I feel its one of the best products out there and really wanted to love this Mineral SPF 30 Tinted Sunscreen Face Lotion, but unfortunately actually hated it. It has a very strange texture and after a while of wearing it becomes greasy. I was hoping to exchange it for the regular Sun Bum sunblock lotion that I love, but unfortunately I'm stuck with this product as the company doesn't allow exchanges :(.
Good, lightweight and as it says, is a tiny. Gives a bit of a blurring affect with a slight tint but no coverage. Recommend for a day at the beach or a hike. Will be purchasing again.

avis.titre: Finally! A face tinted sunblock I love!
avis.texte: I don‚'t think I have ever reviewed anything, but I had to review this tinted sunblock for your face. I have always wanted a tinted sunscreen that goes on like this. It makes your skin feel and look like you have a healthy glow. AND THE BEST PART‚.you can reapply and it‚'s almost like touching up your make up because of the subtle tint. A little goes a long way so start with just a small drop.
I struggle with finding an SPF that doesn't leave a white, weird texture. This one is good. It also doesn't make my skin super oily.
Always get compliments on my skin when I wear this and it protects me from the rays. Also no nasty breakouts. It‚'s a win win win!!!
dries out my skin so bad!! also when i apply on top of my moisturizer it doesn't apply well.
Works great and you only need to use a tiny bit to cover your whole face and neck.

I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin and I've been trying to find a sunscreen that doesn't cause breakouts but doesn't leave a white cast. This one does the trick. I put it on over my moisturizer and it leaves a nice matte finish. Because of the tint, it doesn't leave a very noticeable white cast, although my skin does look a bit paler when using this. It applies evenly and easily. I haven't found a better sunscreen that ticks all of the boxes. The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is that it is hard to find and the bottle is small, so I'll go through it quickly.

avis.titre: Works well for my dry skin
avis.texte: I spent so much time on looking for a great face sunscreen. I have a very dry and sensitive skin and this sunscreen leaves my skin hydrated. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Softest, most lightweight sunscreen I've found
avis.texte: One of the softest, most lightweight face sunscreens I've found. Rather than dreading having to wear sunscreen, I actually look forward to putting this on. Only con I would say is that the depositor is a little messy because of the way it's designed, but not a huge deal.

I just purchased a bottle and love it, so I'm grabbing two on sale. It really lasts and doesn't feel greasy once it's absorbed. That is my experience and it's been really hot and balmy. It is probably best for light to medium. CeraVe tinted sunscreen is still my perfect color match but this wears much better and stays a Matt finish. In the evening I wonder if I should just use this stuff instead of tinted primers or bb creams. It's that good.

This stuff is so light and smooth on the skin. I have never burned when using it either. I wear this in many settings and it never fails and is always comfortable - swimming, in 90+ degree summer sun, day-to-day running around town.
